G2900.b:
⟪κραταιός⟫, -ά, -όν
(< κράτος), (in cl. poët. form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨חָזָק⁩ and cognates;] ⟪strong⟫, ⟪mighty⟫: ⟦1 Peter 5:6|I Pe 5:6⟧.†

G2901.b:

(late form of κρατύνω; < κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨חזק⁩;] ⟪to strengthen⟫; pass., ⟪to wax strong⟫: ⟦Luke 2:40|Lk 2:40⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 16:13|I Co 16:13⟧; πνεύματι, ⟦Luke 1:80|Lk 1:80⟧; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, ⟦Ephesians 3:16|Eph 3:16⟧.†

G2902.b:
⟪κρατέω⟫, -ῶ
(< κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨חזק⁩ hi., also for ⁨אחז⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to be strong⟫, ⟪mighty⟫, hence, ⟪to rule⟫, ⟪be master⟫, ⟪prevail⟫ (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: ⟦Ezra 1:1|Es 1:1⟧, I Es 4:38, Wi 14:19, al.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to get possession of⟫, ⟪obtain⟫, ⟪take hold of⟫ (Hdt., Thuc., al.): c. gen. rei (M, Pr., 65), ⟦Acts 27:13|Ac 27:13⟧; τ. χειρός, ⟦Matthew 9:25|Mt 9:25⟧, ⟦Mark 1:31|Mk 1:31⟧ ⟦Mark 5:41|5:41⟧ ⟦Mark 9:27|9:27⟧, ⟦Luke 8:54|Lk 8:54⟧; c. acc. rei, ⟦Matthew 12:11|Mt 12:11⟧; c. acc. pers., ⟦Matthew 14:3|Mt 14:3⟧ ⟦Matthew 18:28|18:28⟧ ⟦Matthew 21:46|21:46⟧ ⟦Matthew 22:6|22:6⟧ ⟦Matthew 26:4|26:4⟧, ⟦Matthew 26:48|48⟧ ff., ⟦Mark 3:21|Mk 3:21⟧ ⟦Mark 6:17|6:17⟧ ⟦Mark 12:12|12:12⟧ ⟦Mark 14:1|14:1⟧, ⟦Mark 14:44|44⟧ ff., ⟦Acts 3:11|Ac 3:11⟧ ⟦Acts 24:6|24:6⟧, ⟦Revelation 20:2|Re 20:2⟧ (cf. ⟦2 Samuel 6:6|II Ki 6:6⟧).
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to hold⟫, ⟪hold fast⟫ (Æsch., Polyb., al.): c. acc. rei, ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, ⟦Revelation 2:1|Re 2:1⟧. Metaph.: c. acc. pers., pass., ⟦Acts 2:24|Ac 2:24⟧; c. acc. rei, ⟦Revelation 2:13|Re 2:13⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:25|25⟧ ⟦Revelation 3:11|3:11⟧; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), ⟦Colossians 2:19|Col 2:19⟧; τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, ⟦Mark 7:3|Mk 7:3⟧, ⟦Mark 7:4|4⟧, ⟦Mark 7:8|8⟧ ⟦Mark 9:10|9:10⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 2:15|II Th 2:15⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:14|Re 2:14⟧, ⟦Revelation 2:15|15⟧; c. gen. rei, ⟦Hebrews 4:14|He 4:14⟧ ⟦Hebrews 6:18|6:18⟧; of sins, ⟪to retain⟫, ⟦John 20:23|Jo 20:23⟧; of restraint, seq. ἵνα μή, ⟦Revelation 7:1|Re 7:1⟧; pass., seq. τοῦ μή, ⟦Luke 24:16|Lk 24:16⟧.†

G2903.b:

⟪2.⟫ ⟪noblest⟫, ⟪best⟫ (cf. κρείσσων), ⟪most excellent⟫ (Pind., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), ⟦Luke 1:3|Lk 1:3⟧, ⟦Acts 23:26|Ac 23:26⟧ ⟦Acts 24:3|24:3⟧ ⟦Acts 26:25|26:25⟧.†

⟪1.⟫ ⟪strength⟫, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪power⟫, ⟪might⟫: ⟦Hebrews 2:14|He 2:14⟧; τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, ⟦Ephesians 1:19|Eph 1:19⟧ ⟦Ephesians 6:10|6:10⟧ (⟦Isaiah 40:26|Is 40:26⟧, ⟦Daniel 4:27|Da TH 4:27⟧); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, ⟦Colossians 1:11|Col 1:11⟧; κατὰ κράτος, ⟪mightily⟫, ⟦Acts 19:20|Ac 19:20⟧; ⟪a mighty deed⟫, ⟪an act of power⟫, ⟦Luke 1:51|Lk 1:51⟧; in doxologies, ⟦1 Timothy 6:16|I Ti 6:16⟧, ⟦1 Peter 4:11|I Pe 4:11⟧ ⟦1 Peter 5:11|5:11⟧, ⟦Jude 1:25|Ju 25⟧, ⟦Revelation 1:6|Re 1:6⟧ ⟦Revelation 5:13|5:13⟧.†

G2917.b:
⟪κρίμα⟫ (Bl., § 27, 2), -τος, τό
(< κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨מִשְׁפָּט⁩;] the issue of a judicial process, hence,
⟪1.⟫ ⟪judgment⟫, the decision passed on the faults of others: ⟦Matthew 7:2|Mt 7:2⟧; in forensic sense, c. gen. pun., ⟦Luke 24:20|Lk 24:20⟧; esp. of the judgment of God, ⟦Romans 2:2|Ro 2:2⟧ ⟦Romans 5:16|5:16⟧ ⟦Romans 11:33|11:33⟧ (ICC, in l.), ⟦2 Peter 2:3|II Pe 2:3⟧, ⟦Jude 1:4|Ju 4⟧; κ. λαμβάι εσθαι, ⟦Matthew 23:13|Mt 23:13⟧ (Rec., R, mg.), ⟦Mark 12:40|Mk 12:40⟧, ⟦Luke 20:47|Lk 20:47⟧, ⟦Romans 13:2|Ro 13:2⟧, ⟦James 3:1|Ja 3:1⟧; ἔχειν, ⟦1 Timothy 5:12|I Ti 5:12⟧; βαστάζειν, ⟦Galatians 5:10|Ga 5:10⟧; ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:29|I Co 11:29⟧; εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:34|I Co 11:34⟧; εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., ⟦Luke 23:40|Lk 23:40⟧; c. gen. obj., ⟦Romans 3:8|Ro 3:8⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 3:6|I Ti 3:6⟧, ⟦Revelation 17:1|Re 17:1⟧; of God's judgment through Christ, ⟦John 9:39|Jo 9:39⟧; τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, ⟦1 Peter 4:17|I Pe 4:17⟧; τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, ⟦Acts 24:25|Ac 24:25⟧; κ. αἰώνιον, ⟦Hebrews 6:2|He 6:2⟧; ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τ. κ. ὐμῶν, ⟦Revelation 18:20|Re 18:20⟧; of the right of judgment, ⟦Revelation 20:4|Re 20:4⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a matter⟫ for judgment, ⟪a law-suit⟫, ⟪a case⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 6:7|I Co 6:7⟧.†

G2919.b:

[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁפט⁩, also for ⁨דּין⁩, ⁨ריב⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to⟫ ⟪separate⟫, ⟪select⟫, ⟪choose⟫ (cl.; in LXX: II Mac 13:15).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to approve⟫, ⟪esteem⟫: ⟦Romans 14:5|Ro 14:5⟧.
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to be of opinion⟫, ⟪judge⟫, ⟪think⟫: ⟦Luke 7:43|Lk 7:43⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:13|I Co 11:13⟧; seq. τοῦτο ὅτι, ⟦2 Corinthians 5:14|II Co 5:14⟧; c. acc. et inf., ⟦Acts 16:15|Ac 16:15⟧; c. acc. et pred., ⟦Acts 13:46|Ac 13:46⟧ ⟦Acts 26:8|26:8⟧.

(Field, Notes, 167), ⟦Acts 20:16|Ac 20:16⟧ ⟦Acts 25:25|25:25⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 2:2|I Co 2:2⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 5:3|5:3⟧, ⟦Titus 3:12|Tit 3:12⟧ (cf. I Mac 11:33, Wi 8:9, al.); c. acc. et inf., ⟦Acts 21:25|Ac 21:25⟧ ⟦Acts 27:1|27:1⟧.
⟪5.⟫ ⟪to judge⟫, ⟪adjudge⟫, ⟪pronounce judgment⟫: absol., ⟦John 8:16|Jo 8:16⟧, ⟦John 8:26|26⟧; seq. κατά, c. acc., ⟦John 7:24|Jo 7:24⟧ ⟦John 8:15|8:15⟧; κρίσιν κ., ⟦John 7:24|Jo 7:24⟧; τ. δίκαιον, ⟦Luke 12:57|Lk 12:57⟧ (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, ⟦John 18:31|Jo 18:31⟧, ⟦Acts 23:3|Ac 23:3⟧, al.; pass., ⟦Romans 3:4|Ro 3:4⟧(LXX); of God's judgment, ⟦John 5:30|Jo 5:30⟧ ⟦John 8:50|8:50⟧, ⟦Romans 2:16|Ro 2:16⟧ ⟦Romans 3:6|3:6⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 4:1|II Ti 4:1⟧, ⟦1 Peter 4:5|I Pe 4:5⟧, al.
⟪6.⟫ = κατακρίνω, ⟪to condemn⟫ (cl.): ⟦Acts 13:27|Ac 13:27⟧; of God's judgment, ⟦John 3:18|Jo 3:18⟧ ⟦John 5:22|5:22⟧ ⟦John 12:47|12:47⟧, ⟦John 12:48|48⟧, ⟦Acts 7:7|Ac 7:7⟧, ⟦Romans 2:12|Ro 2:12⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:32|I Co 11:32⟧, ⟦Hebrews 10:30|He 10:30⟧(LXX), ⟦James 5:9|Ja 5:9⟧, ⟦Revelation 19:2|Re 19:2⟧, al.
⟪7.⟫ As in LXX (for ⁨שׁפט⁩), ⟪to rule⟫, ⟪govern⟫ (⟦2 Kings 15:5|IV Ki 15:5⟧, ⟦Psalms 2:10|Ps 2:10⟧, al.): ⟦Matthew 19:28|Mt 19:28⟧, ⟦Luke 22:30|Lk 22:30⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 6:3|I Co 6:3⟧.
⟪8.⟫ ⟪to bring to trial⟫ (cl.); mid., ⟪to go to law⟫: c. dat. pers., ⟦Matthew 5:40|Mt 5:40⟧; seq. μετά, c. gen. pers. (of the opponent), ἐπί, c. gen. ⟪1.⟫ ⟪the people⟫ at large (Hom., al.), esp. of people assembled: ⟦Matthew 27:25|Mt 27:25⟧, ⟦Luke 1:21|Lk 1:21⟧ ⟦Luke 3:15|3:15⟧ al.; pl. (Hom., al., π.; v. MM, xvi), ⟦Acts 4:27|Ac 4:27⟧.
